nodes.title: Generalized hypergeometric coefficient

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a field and $A$ a topological ring that is a $K$-algebra. For finite multisets $a$ and $b$ of elements of $K$, the generalized hypergeometric series is the formal multilinear series on $A$ whose $n$-th term is the $n$-linear map $(x_1, \dots, x_n) \mapsto c_n \, x_1 x_2 \cdots x_n$, where $c_n \in K$ is the $n$-th generalized hypergeometric coefficient with upper parameters $a$ and lower parameters $b$.
nodes.title: Generalized hypergeometric series

nodes.title: Terminating generalized hypergeometric series are finite sums

nodes.summary: For finite multisets $a$ and $b$ of complex numbers and $z \in \mathbb{C}$, the value ${}_pF_q(a; b; z)$, where $p = |a|$ and $q = |b|$, is the sum $\sum_{n \ge 0} c_n z^n$, where $c_n$ is the $n$-th generalized hypergeometric coefficient with upper parameters $a$ and lower parameters $b$.
nodes.title: Generalized hypergeometric function

nodes.summary: Let $B$ be a finite multiset of complex numbers that is admissible as lower parameters. Then for every $b \in B$ and every natural number $n$, the rising factorial $(b)_n = b(b+1)\cdots(b+n-1)$, with $(b)_0 = 1$, is nonzero.
nodes.title: Rising factorials at admissible lower parameters are nonzero

nodes.summary: A finite multiset $B$ of complex numbers is admissible as lower parameters if no element of $B$ is $0$ or a negative integer, that is, $-k \notin B$ for every natural number $k$.
nodes.title: Admissible lower parameters

nodes.summary: Let $a$ and $b$ be finite multisets of complex numbers, and let $c_n$ be the $n$-th generalized hypergeometric coefficient with upper parameters $a$ and lower parameters $b$. If $-N \in a$ for some natural number $N$, then for every $z \in \mathbb{C}$ the family $(c_n z^n)_{n \ge 0}$ is summable, that is, the generalized hypergeometric series with these parameters is summable at $z$.
nodes.title: Terminating generalized hypergeometric series are summable

nodes.summary: For finite multisets $a$ and $b$ of complex numbers and $z \in \mathbb{C}$, the generalized hypergeometric series with upper parameters $a$ and lower parameters $b$ is summable at $z$ if the family $(c_n z^n)_{n \ge 0}$ is summable in $\mathbb{C}$, where $c_n$ is the $n$-th generalized hypergeometric coefficient.
nodes.title: Summability of the generalized hypergeometric series

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
